fields.article_title: My Experience at Accra International Airport
fields.introduction:
As a student studying Airport Passenger Handling and Operations at ITTI, visiting Kotoka
International Airport was one of the most exciting and educational experiences I have had. The
visit helped me gain practical knowledge about airport operations and gave me a better
understanding of the aviation industry. It also allowed me to connect the theories I learn in class
with real-life airport activities.
When I arrived at the airport, I immediately noticed the busy environment. Many passengers were
moving around with their luggage while airport staff worked hard to ensure that everything was
operating smoothly. Although there were many people at the airport, the environment was well
organized. This showed me how important planning, discipline, and teamwork are in airport
operations.
